keen_edge.name: Keen Edge
keen_edge.description: Maintain the hunter's edge: blade attacks deal 10% more damage. Preparation helps; it cannot decide whose account is true.

measured_riposte.name: Measured Riposte
measured_riposte.description: Recover your breath after a clean read: a successful parry restores 15 stamina. Useful when you need an opening rather than a killing blow.

fell_weight.name: Fell Weight
fell_weight.description: Commit to a deliberate strike: heavy attacks gain a 20% damage multiplier in addition to your blade practice. Their stamina cost still applies.

hardened_vow.name: Hardened Vow
hardened_vow.description: Learn to stay on your feet: maximum health increases by 20. This grants room to recover from a mistake, not immunity.

sure_step.name: Sure Step
sure_step.description: Keep a reserve for the next attack: dodging costs 5 less stamina. Step clear of a telegraph instead of trading blows.

redroot_lore.name: Redroot Lore
redroot_lore.description: Make each remedy count: Redroot Potions restore 15 additional health. This applies to purchased and crafted potions alike.

kindled_core.name: Kindled Core
kindled_core.description: Control the flame's demand: Oathfire costs 10 less stamina. Keep enough breath to defend after using it.

far_reach.name: Far Reach
far_reach.description: Work from a safer distance: Oathfire range increases by 2 metres. Clear sight and a readable opening still matter.

ashen_flow.name: Ashen Flow
ashen_flow.description: Recover the flame sooner: Oathfire cooldown is reduced by 1 second. Its range and stamina rules remain in force.
